explanation: Merge of main into the staleness pass. From main: From main: CHANGELOG.md's Unreleased section records that Enter in the gene search selects the gene typed. No guidance, command, configuration or workflow changed. Project guidance says to run build:search-names after build:nomenclature, that it writes names.js and renames.js, that its --check fails when either is stale, and where its rule tests live. CONTEXT.md defines the rename group, its join rules and pickStoredMember. From this branch: catalog.json corrects the geo_replication summary and gives the ui-change workflow the six modules workflows.md already rules on; the context README drops the pnpm -- argument and the LFS and separate-CI claims; script headers stop citing build:tracker, prebuild and .mjs names and document behaviour-changing flags and env vars; seoPages pluralises one study and seoGuides keeps the software citation apart from the data-export DOI. analyze:hfd runs scripts/analyze_hfd_r460.mts, which refuses any Rscript but R 4.6.0 and runs the regen-r460 HFD and FGSEA producers.
